scope: Actual rank-one projected reference for arbitrary-length unbounded cubic selector weights

endpoints.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.supplementalH_rankOne_mulVec
endpoints.expanded_type: ∀ {r : ℕ} (u g : RectangleCLT.Vector r), (RectangleCLT.Companion.rankOne u).mulVec g = RectangleCLT.faceDot u g • u

endpoints.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.supplementalH_rankOne_transpose
endpoints.expanded_type: ∀ {r : ℕ} (u : RectangleCLT.Vector r), (RectangleCLT.Companion.rankOne u).transpose = RectangleCLT.Companion.rankOne u

endpoints.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.supplementalH_rankOne_idempotent
endpoints.expanded_type:
∀ {r : ℕ} (u : RectangleCLT.Vector r),
  RectangleCLT.vectorNormSq u = 1 →
    RectangleCLT.Companion.rankOne u * RectangleCLT.Companion.rankOne u = RectangleCLT.Companion.rankOne u

endpoints.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.supplementalH_rankOne_coordinate
endpoints.expanded_type:
∀ {r : ℕ} (u g : RectangleCLT.Vector r),
  RectangleCLT.vectorNormSq u = 1 →
    RectangleCLT.faceDot u ((RectangleCLT.Companion.rankOne u).mulVec g) = RectangleCLT.faceDot u g

endpoints.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.supplementalH_rankOne_normSq
endpoints.expanded_type:
∀ {r : ℕ} (u g : RectangleCLT.Vector r),
  RectangleCLT.vectorNormSq u = 1 →
    RectangleCLT.vectorNormSq ((RectangleCLT.Companion.rankOne u).mulVec g) = RectangleCLT.faceDot u g ^ 2

endpoints.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.supplementalH_cubic_mean_reference_bound
endpoints.expanded_type:
∀ {p r K : ℕ} (s : RectangleCLT.FaceSmoother p) (A : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin r) ℝ) (v : RectangleCLT.Vector p) (σ : ℝ)
  (α : Fin (K + 1) → RectangleCLT.Face p),
  (∀ (i : Fin (K + 1)), α i ∈ s.faces) →
    RectangleCLT.vectorNormSq (RectangleCLT.Companion.selectorFaceNormal A (α 0)) = 1 →
      RectangleCLTArxivV1.supplementalHCubicMeanEnergy s (σ • A) v α
          (RectangleCLT.Companion.selectorFaceNormal A (α 0)) ≤
        ∫ (g : RectangleCLT.Vector r),
            RectangleCLTArxivV1.supplementalHPositiveDirection (RectangleCLT.Companion.selectorFaceNormal A (α 0)) g *
                RectangleCLT.Companion.selectorWeight s α ((σ • A).mulVec g + v) *
              RectangleCLT.faceDot (RectangleCLT.Companion.selectorFaceNormal A (α 0)) g ^
                2 ∂RectangleCLT.standardGaussian r +
          (2 *
              RectangleCLT.Companion.weightMass (RectangleCLT.standardGaussian r) fun g =>
                RectangleCLTArxivV1.supplementalHPositiveDirection (RectangleCLT.Companion.selectorFaceNormal A (α 0))
                    g *
                  RectangleCLT.Companion.selectorWeight s α ((σ • A).mulVec g + v)) *
            Real.log
              ((∫ (g : RectangleCLT.Vector r),
                  RectangleCLTArxivV1.supplementalHPositiveDirection (RectangleCLT.Companion.selectorFaceNormal A (α 0))
                      g *
                    RectangleCLT.Companion.oneFaceReference s (α 0)
                      ((σ • A).mulVec g + v) ∂RectangleCLT.standardGaussian r) /
                RectangleCLT.Companion.weightMass (RectangleCLT.standardGaussian r) fun g =>
                  RectangleCLTArxivV1.supplementalHPositiveDirection (RectangleCLT.Companion.selectorFaceNormal A (α 0))
                      g *
                    RectangleCLT.Companion.selectorWeight s α ((σ • A).mulVec g + v))

            RectangleCLT.faceDot (RectangleCLT.Companion.selectorFaceNormal A (α 0)) g ^

        (2 *
